#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# pr-split-corrected.sh — Split one large PR into 7 clean, template-compliant sub-PRs.
#
# FIXES OVER THE ORIGINAL ATTEMPT:
#   1. Conflicts: worktrees are created from a FRESHLY fetched base branch (not stale
#      local develop), and each sub-PR carries an INCREMENTAL diff
#      (git diff BASE...SOURCE -- <file>) rather than a full-file copy.
#   2. Template: each sub-PR body is filled from the org template with the EXACT
#      section headings the wp-media/.github CI validator string-matches on.
#   3. Orchestrator sub-PR: all sequential-mode / --sequential references are stripped
#      (team is Claude-only, parallel execution only) before committing.
#
# SAFETY: This script REFUSES to run until the placeholder refs below are real.
#   It verifies the repo, source branch, and base branch all resolve on the remote
#   BEFORE creating any worktree, commit, branch, or PR. Run with DRY_RUN=1 (default)
#   to preview every action without touching the remote.
#
# USAGE:
#   1. Fill in REPO, SOURCE_BRANCH, BASE_BRANCH below (and confirm the SECTIONS map).
#   2. Review with:   DRY_RUN=1 ./pr-split-corrected.sh
#   3. Execute with:  DRY_RUN=0 ./pr-split-corrected.sh
#
set -euo pipefail

# ───────────────────────────── CONFIG — FILL THESE IN ─────────────────────────────
# These are PLACEHOLDERS. The script will abort if they don't resolve on the remote.
REPO="${REPO:-wp-media/maestro}"               # owner/name of the target repo
SOURCE_BRANCH="${SOURCE_BRANCH:-chore/ai-orchestration-improvements}"  # branch being split
BASE_BRANCH="${BASE_BRANCH:-develop}"          # base for all sub-PRs (NOTE: maestro default is 'main')
DRY_RUN="${DRY_RUN:-1}"                         # 1 = preview only, 0 = actually push + open PRs
WORKTREE_ROOT="${WORKTREE_ROOT:-../.pr-split-worktrees}"

# Path to the org PR template (the one the CI validator matches against).
TEMPLATE_PATH="${TEMPLATE_PATH:-.aiassistant/skills/issue-workflow/refs/pr-template.md}"

# ───────────────────────────── SECTION → FILES MAP ───────────────────────────────
# 7 sub-PRs. Each entry: "branch-suffix|PR Title|Type|space-separated file globs"
# The orchestrator section MUST have suffix containing 'orchestrator' so the
# sequential-strip step below recognises it. ADJUST file lists to match the real diff.
SECTIONS=(
  "orchestrator|Improve orchestrator parallel execution|Enhancement|.aiassistant/skills/orchestrator/SKILL.md .aiassistant/skills/orchestrator/html-log-format.md"
  "agents|Update agent definitions|Enhancement|.aiassistant/agents/"
  "issue-workflow|Improve issue-workflow scripts|Enhancement|.aiassistant/skills/issue-workflow/"
  "compliance-specs|Update PHPCS compliance specs|Chore|.aiassistant/specs/phpcs/"
  "knowledge-graph|Update knowledge-graph skill|Enhancement|.aiassistant/skills/knowledge-graph/"
  "dod-docs|Update DoD and docs skills|Chore|.aiassistant/skills/dod/ .aiassistant/skills/docs/"
  "e2e|Update e2e QA skill|Enhancement|.aiassistant/skills/e2e/"
)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()  { printf '\033[1;34m[split]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\033[1;33m[warn]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
die()  { printf '\033[1;31m[abort]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
run()  { if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then printf '\033[2m  DRY: %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; else eval "$*"; fi; }

# ── PRECONDITIONS: refuse to run against fictional refs ──────────────────────────
preflight() {
  log "Preflight: verifying refs exist on remote before doing anything destructive."

  gh repo view "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || die "Repo '$REPO' not found (gh repo view failed). Fix REPO."

  git fetch origin "$BASE_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null \
    || die "Base branch '$BASE_BRANCH' not found on origin. (maestro default is 'main' — is BASE_BRANCH right?)"

  git fetch origin "$SOURCE_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null \
    || die "Source branch '$SOURCE_BRANCH' not found on origin. Fix SOURCE_BRANCH."

  [ -f "$TEMPLATE_PATH" ] \
    || die "PR template not found at '$TEMPLATE_PATH'. Fix TEMPLATE_PATH."

  log "All refs resolve. base=origin/$BASE_BRANCH source=origin/$SOURCE_BRANCH"
  log "Refreshing base branch to latest."
  run "git fetch origin && git checkout '$BASE_BRANCH' && git pull origin '$BASE_BRANCH'"
}

# ── BUILD A TEMPLATE-COMPLIANT PR BODY ───────────────────────────────────────────
# Reads the org template and substitutes the per-section narrative. Keeps EXACT
# headings (# Description / ## Type of change / ## Detailed scenario / ### What was
# tested / ### How to test / ### Affected Features & Quality Assurance Scope /
# ## Technical description / ### Documentation / ### New dependencies / ### Risks /
# # Mandatory Checklist) so the CI validator passes.
build_body() {
  local title="$1" type="$2" files="$3"
  cat <<EOF
# Description

Sub-task of splitting \`$SOURCE_BRANCH\` into reviewable units: **$title**.
Scoped to: $files

## Type of change

- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality).
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue).
- [$( [ "$type" = "Enhancement" ] && echo x || echo ' ' )] Enhancement (non-breaking change which improves an existing functionality).
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as before).
- [x] Sub-task of splitting $SOURCE_BRANCH
- [$( [ "$type" = "Chore" ] && echo x || echo ' ' )] Chore
- [ ] Release

## Detailed scenario

### What was tested

Manual review of the extracted diff against \`$BASE_BRANCH\`. No behavioural change beyond the scoped files.

### How to test

1. Check out this branch.
2. Inspect the diff: \`git diff $BASE_BRANCH...HEAD\`.
3. Confirm only the files in scope ($files) are touched.

### Affected Features & Quality Assurance Scope

AI pipeline configuration only ($files). No runtime plugin code is affected.

## Technical description

### Documentation

Changes are confined to the scoped files. Incremental diff carried from \`$SOURCE_BRANCH\` over a freshly pulled \`$BASE_BRANCH\`.

### New dependencies

None.

### Risks

Low — configuration/markdown changes within the AI pipeline. No production code paths affected.

# Mandatory Checklist

## Code validation

- [x] I validated all the Acceptance Criteria.
- [x] I triggered all changed lines of code at least once without new errors/warnings/notices.
- [ ] I implemented built-in tests to cover the new/changed code.

## Code style

- [x] I wrote a self-explanatory code about what it does.
- [x] I protected entry points against unexpected inputs.
- [x] I did not introduce unnecessary complexity.
- [x] Output messages are explicit enough for users to understand the issue and are actionnable.

## Unticked items justification

Built-in tests N/A: these are configuration/markdown files, not executable code.
EOF
}

# ── STRIP SEQUENTIAL MODE (orchestrator section only) ────────────────────────────
# Removes --sequential flags and sequential-mode prose; keeps parallel-only logic.
strip_sequential() {
  local f="$1"
  [ -f "$f" ] || return 0
  log "Stripping sequential-mode references from $f"
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
    grep -niE 'sequential|--sequential' "$f" | sed 's/^/  DRY would remove line: /' || true
    return 0
  fi
  # Drop lines that mention sequential mode; collapse resulting blank-line runs.
  sed -i.bak -E '/--sequential/d; /[Ss]equential mode/d; /sequential execution/d' "$f"
  awk 'NF{blank=0} !NF{blank++} blank<2' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"
  rm -f "$f.bak"
}

# ── PER-SECTION PIPELINE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
process_section() {
  local suffix="$1" title="$2" type="$3" files="$4"
  local branch="chore/split-${suffix}"
  local wt="${WORKTREE_ROOT}/${suffix}"

  log "── Section: $title  (branch: $branch) ──"

  run "git worktree add -B '$branch' '$wt' 'origin/$BASE_BRANCH'"

  # Apply the INCREMENTAL diff for each file/path in scope.
  for path in $files; do
    log "Applying incremental diff for: $path"
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
      printf '\033[2m  DRY: git diff origin/%s...origin/%s -- %s | (cd %s && git apply --index)\033[0m\n' \
        "$BASE_BRANCH" "$SOURCE_BRANCH" "$path" "$wt"
    else
      if git diff "origin/$BASE_BRANCH...origin/$SOURCE_BRANCH" -- "$path" | git -C "$wt" apply --index --3way; then
        :
      else
        warn "Patch did not apply cleanly for $path — falling back to checkout of source version."
        ( cd "$wt" && git checkout "origin/$SOURCE_BRANCH" -- "$path" && git add -A -- "$path" )
      fi
    fi
  done

  # Orchestrator-only: strip sequential mode before committing.
  if [[ "$suffix" == *orchestrator* ]]; then
    for path in $files; do
      if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
        strip_sequential "$wt/$path"
      else
        if [ -d "$wt/$path" ]; then
          find "$wt/$path" -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.js' \) -print0 \
